Here is a transcription of the historical parish registry document from `image_ee19c8.png`.

The record is written in Latin and split across two columns, covering the end of **1863** and the beginning of **1864**. Standard abbreviations of the period (such as *Spons_bus* for *Sponsoribus*, meaning godparents) are transcribed as written, and the name of the officiating priest, **Joannes Quinlan C.C.**, appears at the end of most entries.
